Split the range at mid. In a rotated sorted array, at least one of the two halves is always fully sorted. Can you tell which one?
If nums[low] <= nums[mid], the left half is sorted; otherwise the right half is. In the sorted half you can check with two comparisons whether the target is inside it.

Left half sorted: if nums[low] <= target < nums[mid], go left (high = mid - 1), else go right. Right half sorted: if nums[mid] < target <= nums[high], go right (low = mid + 1), else go left. Stop when nums[mid] == target or low > high.
